newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-SOLSKJAER LEADS MANCHESTER UNITED TO JAPAN WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOLSKJAER LEADS MANCHESTER UNITED TO JAPAN WIN.

text.p: Norway striker Ole Gunnar Solskjaer scored both Manchester United's goals on Tuesday in a 2-1 win over J-League club Urawa Red Diamonds.
The victory meant the English premier league champions wrapped up their three-game Asian tour undefeated after beating Thailand 2-0 in Bangkok and Hong Kong's South China club 1-0.
Solskjaer gave United a 13th minute lead with a well-placed header before driving in his second from 10 metres out 26 minutes later.

Urawa, who finished ninth in the J-League first-stage competition, pulled a goal back for the 18,000 crowd in this city which adjoins Tokyo when German defender Guido Buchwald's free kick produced a diving header from Kenji Oshiba.
